# Vendored SO-101 simulation assets

The STL files in `Simulation/SO101/assets/` are copied from the official
[TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100](https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 )
repository under its Apache License 2.0.

They are the exact asset filenames referenced by the checked-in MuJoCo models.
The assets were fetched from upstream `main` at commit
`eecbe3e0a9ebb23e25ad7b2759b03884c6660903`.

The upstream license is preserved in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).
Only the simulation assets required by RoboGuardian are vendored.
